questions: Is the backoff logic correctly handling the case where backoff_ms is exactly J2534_BACKOFF_CAP_MS / 2, which would cause it to be doubled and exceed the cap? The condition checks '< J2534_BACKOFF_CAP_MS' which means if backoff_ms equals 2500 (J2534_BACKOFF_CAP_MS / 2), it will be doubled to 5000, which is exactly the cap. This may be intended but needs clarification.

Are there any potential race conditions or thread safety issues with how backoff_ms is being modified and read across different worker modes in j2534_worker? Since this function modifies shared state, proper synchronization should be considered.
nits: Consider adding a comment explaining why the condition checks '< J2534_BACKOFF_CAP_MS' instead of '<= J2534_BACKOFF_CAP_MS' to avoid confusion about the exact boundary behavior.
